parallels.note: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so I will do to you.”

translations.web: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.
translations.bsb: You have done these things, and I kept silent; you thought I was just like you. But now I rebuke you and accuse you to your face.
translations.kjv: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.
translations.asv: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; Thou thoughtest that I was altogether such a one as thyself: But I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.
